# 03 Resolve a parsed class document into a validated ClassModel

## Outcome

`buildGraphModel` gains its third dispatch branch, and `buildClassModel` turns a `ClassDocument`
into a validated `ClassModel`: classes created implicitly from relationships, duplicate class
declarations merged, relationship ids assigned, and the `timeline:` block resolved against class
and relationship ids.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `buildGraphModel` on a `kind: "class"` document dispatches to `buildClassModel`; flowchart
  and sequence dispatch are unchanged and their existing tests pass unmodified.
- [ ] The same class declared twice — which is what the parser now hands over, since it emits a
  separate `ClassDecl` for each mention, implicit or explicit — merges into one class whose
  members are the union in declaration order, rather than erroring or duplicating. This is the
  real work of this ticket: the parser declares, the model reconciles.
- [ ] A conflicting annotation across two declarations of the same class produces a warning,
  keeping the first.
- [ ] Defensive: a relationship whose endpoint has no `ClassDecl` at all still resolves, creating
  the class. The real parser guarantees this cannot happen, so this path exists only for
  hand-built documents and future callers — assert it, but do not mistake it for the
  implicit-declaration behavior, which lives in the parser (see spec.md's Design contract).
- [ ] Two relationships between the same pair get ids `A-B` and `A-B#2`, matching the flowchart
  edge-id convention.
- [ ] A `timeline:` entry referencing a class id or a relationship id resolves; one referencing an
  unknown id produces an error diagnostic and is dropped, leaving the rest of the model intact.
- [ ] Members, relationship types, labels and multiplicity pass through unchanged — this stage
  validates and identifies, it does not reinterpret.

## Test seam

`buildClassModel(document: ClassDocument): ClassModelResult` — unit level, pure function,
hand-built `ClassDocument` fixtures (does not need ticket 01's real parser, only its frozen
types).
